conservative.requirements: 2 power, a free hand. Effect: While this card is recharging, a fiery sword materialises in your grasp. Treat the sword as a hand weapon with DR 5, CR 2, and Pierce 1 that deals fiery damage. You can dismiss or resummon the sword as a manoeuvre while this card is recharging.

success.description: As above, plus while wielding the sword your Strength is increased by 1.

reckless.requirements: 2 power, a free hand. Effect: While this card is recharging, a fiery sword materialises in your grasp. Treat the sword as a hand weapon with DR 5, CR 2, and Pierce 1 that deals fiery damage. Attacks you make with the sword gain +1. You can dismiss or resummon the sword as a manoeuvre while this card is recharging.
